meta.source: GrantConnect (Department of Finance), Grant Award records, via parli.db ext_grants / ext_grant_details
meta.licence: CC BY 3.0 AU (GrantConnect, Department of Finance)
meta.threshold: Every Commonwealth grant award must be published on GrantConnect within 21 days of the agreement taking effect (mandatory since 31 December 2017). Aggregate awards bundle many small recipients and are shown as not disclosed.
caveats: Grant totals are awarded values as published; a varied award counts at its current value. Aggregate awards and awards whose recipient was withheld sit in the not-disclosed bucket.
A recipient counts as a donor when its ABN, or a unique organisation name, matches an entity in the donor register (AEC returns and the exposed state registers). People are never matched by name.
AEC donations and state-register gifts are shown side by side and never summed: AEC returns already include state branch receipts.
A donor receiving a grant is a fact about the public record, not a finding: most programs are open and competitive, and the selection process is shown wherever the source records it.

Recipient ABNs, locations and selection processes come from each award's detail page; the share of dollars with a detail page fetched is in counts.electorate_known_share and counts.abn_known_share. Electorates are mapped from the delivery or recipient postcode and are approximate where a postcode straddles a boundary or a redistribution moved it.

grants.n: The Women's Memorial Playing Field - Rebuild of Memorial project will upgrade and expand the central memorial at the Women's Memorial Playing Fields in St Marys.
The project will refurbish the existing changerooms and construct two new gender neutral changerooms, providing showers and toilets suitable for all participants.
The project will construct a kitchen/canteen facility, change rooms, meeting rooms, and extend and refurbish the social clubrooms for the Kenilworth Football Club at St Marys Park.
The grant activity will repurpose the former Sea-Scouts Hall to form a new Community Centre.
The project will upgrade and redevelop St Marys Park and Environment.
